name: The Scale That Remembers
introDiscord:
The enormous scale beyond the Seal is filled with moving light.

Touching the surrounding water produces images.

Not dreams.

Memories.
introTwitch:
The enormous scale beyond the Seal is filled with moving light.

Touching the surrounding water produces images.

Not dreams.

Memories.

the-scale-that-remembers-approach.prompt:
Three routes circle the luminous scale while ancient scenes ripple
across its surface.

left.message:
Star Candies rest beneath the edge.

For one instant, the scale shows an ocean untouched by ruins.

A Leviathan passes overhead.

The image is so enormous it fills everything.

right.message:
A Primeval Scale Revenant steps from the memory, formed from light and
old instinct.

forward.message:
A calm pool reflects the remembered creature.

Shizuki wrote:

'I finally saw one.

Not alive.

But moving.

It was beautiful.'

left.message:
A Revenant emerges from an image of the Leviathan swimming through a
younger Astral Sea.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests beneath the luminous scale.

forward.message:
"One Berry sits beneath Shizuki's journal.

'It wasn't a monster.

It wasn't a weapon.

It was just...

alive.

This whole place used to be full of them.'"

No joke follows.

the-scale-that-remembers-threshold.prompt: Memory of the Colossus forms where the scale's oldest visions gather.

left.message:
Shizuki's bottle rests beside one final note:

'Rest before going in.

This one matters.'

right.message: A Primeval Revenant rises from the memory.

forward.message:
An old travel offering rests beneath the scale, left by someone who
visited this grave long before Shizuki.

boss-antechamber.name: Memory of the Colossus
boss-antechamber.prompt: The scale releases its oldest memory.

bossPromptDiscord:
The scale releases its oldest memory.

The water disappears beneath an image of the ancient Astral Sea.

A Leviathan larger than every skeleton you crossed swims overhead.

For one impossible moment, the graveyard lives again.

Then something turns within the memory and looks directly at you.

Use /yes to enter Memory of the Colossus or /no to leave the final
memory untouched.
bossPromptTwitch:
The scale releases its oldest memory.

The water disappears beneath an image of the ancient Astral Sea.

A Leviathan larger than every skeleton you crossed swims overhead.

For one impossible moment, the graveyard lives again.

Then something turns within the memory and looks directly at you.

Use !yes to enter Memory of the Colossus or !no to leave the final

bossRetreatText:
You step away.

The ancient sea remains inside the scale.

boss.revealText:
The remembered Leviathan dissolves into light.

From that light, an immense spectral guardian takes form.

Firstwake Revenant reveals itself!

completionText:
The Firstwake Revenant fades.

The scale goes quiet.

One last image remains:

The ancient Leviathan lowering itself beside another of its kind.

Then another.

Dozens.

Hundreds.

This place was not where something hunted them.

It was where they came at the end of their lives.

Leviathan's Wake was always a graveyard.

And farther ahead lies the oldest grave of all.
